title: columnea selloana
intro: Columnea selloana, commonly known as the Sello's Columnea or Sello's Columbine, is a flowering plant species in the family Gesneriaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, with health benefits that include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can be used to treat various ailments such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Columnea selloana include analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it a valuable remedy for pain relief, muscle relaxation, and cough suppression. The bioactive constituents present in Columnea selloana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential applications in traditional medicine.
